Name: More Maru Events ABANDONED
Author: StardustMacaron
Description:
[size=4][This mod is basically abandoned, if you like it and can fix it, feel free to take it and do whatever with it. Use parts of it for other mods, copy the events, do whatever you want. I just can't fix it myself for various reasons, so I'm leaving it up for anyone else to take as they please.]

More Maru Events[/size]

This Mod adds extra heart events for Maru, expanding on her family relationships, her friendships, and her personal motivations and relationship with the Farmer.

[size=4]5 new events:[/size]
[list]
[*]A Three Heart Event expanding on her friendship with Penny.
[*]A Five Heart Event expanding on her relationship with her mother, Robin.
[*]A Seven Heart Event exploring her motivations and goals.
[*]A Nine Heart Event where you can celebrate her birthday with her.
[*]And a secondary event that follows on from her main Ten Heart Event.
[/list]
Other events are planned in future, like post marriage events, but there's no timeline for that yet.

How To Trigger Events:﻿[spoiler]
[list]
[*]Three Heart: Walk into town on a Sunny Day, between 14:00 - 17:00.
[*]Five Heart: Walk into the Carpenters Shop on a Rainy Day.
[*]Seven Heart: Walk to the Mountains from 20:00 - 23:50. Must have seen Maru's Stargazing event.
[*]Nine Heart: On Maru's Birthday, walk into Town if the weather is Sunny.
[*]Ten Heart Extra: After seeing her Ten Heart Event, walk to the Mountains from 21:00 - 23:50.[/spoiler]
[/list]
[size=4]Bugs & Issues:[/size]
[size=2]If you come across anything that doesn't work right, please let me know! (Or if you just spot any typos or spelling errors in dialogue...)[/size]
[size=2]Additionally, if the writing feels awkward or poorly paced at any point, I'm also interested in feedback for that too![/size]

[size=2]I've never written a mod before so feedback is super vital here, and I appreciate all of it![/size]
